responsibilities.cap_5_enforcement: store-side CAS on adventurer_class_states.active_marks length (single-document CAS on state_version)
responsibilities.refresh_behavior: refresh replaces prior application_id atomically; expiry timestamp reset; expires_at = now+10s
responsibilities.duplicate_simultaneous_over_cap: second CAS attempt fails on state_version mismatch → retry sees updated cap and refuses if cap==5
responsibilities.expiration_handling: on-read: expired marks filtered by expires_at < now (soft-eviction on read); on-write: pruned atomically before append
responsibilities.retry_handling: same event_id via apply_event_once → no-op with prior result

rt1_verbatim_preserved: own active Mark required at start = true
own active Mark required at completion = true
one resolution per execution id = true

double_prevention.double_completion: CAS on {drain_execution_id, runtime_status: in_progress, completed_at: null} → transition to resolved atomically
double_prevention.double_reward: reward_resolved=true set atomically in the same CAS transition; retry sees reward_resolved=true and no-ops
double_prevention.completion_after_mark_expiry: at CAS time, check required_mark_application_id present in adventurer_class_states.active_marks AND (mark.expires_at > now) → else reject as MarkExpiredAtCompletion
double_prevention.retry_new_resolution: apply_event_once with event_id keyed on drain_execution_id → duplicate no-op with prior result

atomicity.spend: CAS with precondition fragment_count>=cost · reject if insufficient
atomicity.reset: unconditional set fragment_count=0 within CAS on state_version
atomicity.resource_segment_closing: CAS clear resource_segment_id · retain historical focus_bonus_usage until phase_end reset
atomicity.focus_bonus_usage: CAS increment focus_bonus_usage[segment] up to 2 · reject if already 2

MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.source_of_truth: shared store (Mongo document with lease_holder + fencing_token)
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.lease_behavior: TTL-based · renewal by CAS on fencing_token match
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.failover: expired lease is claimable by next worker · fencing_token guards stale writers
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.retry_handling: retry acquires new lease if prior fencing_token invalidated
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.infrastructure_dependency: Mongo CAS + Mongo clock or app-server clock (with skew tolerance)
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.performance_impact: 1 CAS per acquire + 1 CAS per renewal + 1 CAS per mutation (well within Mongo p95)
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.migration_impact: requires new collection with lease fields OR extension of existing expedition doc
MODEL_A_distributed_lease_per_expedition.agent_recommendation: RECOMMENDED_PRIMARY (subject to PM decision on B0Q02)

MODEL_B_shared_atomic_state_no_persisten.writer_selection: any worker with valid expected_state_version → optimistic concurrency
MODEL_B_shared_atomic_state_no_persisten.ordering_guarantee: per-document serial via state_version (contention may cause more retries)
MODEL_B_shared_atomic_state_no_persisten.performance_impact: higher retry churn under contention · acceptable if per-expedition contention is low (single-user driven)
MODEL_B_shared_atomic_state_no_persisten.migration_impact: requires state_version field on state document
MODEL_B_shared_atomic_state_no_persisten.agent_recommendation: STRONG_ALTERNATIVE (may be sufficient if lease overhead is unwarranted · B0Q02 decision)

MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.writer_selection: single actor instance per expedition_id partition key
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.failover: actor supervisor rehydrates from persisted checkpoint
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.infrastructure_dependency: message broker + actor runtime (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or custom)
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.performance_impact: very low steady-state, but adds hop latency
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.data_loss_risk: MEDIUM (depends on broker durability + actor checkpoint discipline)
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.migration_impact: requires broker introduction — NOT AVAILABLE IN CURRENT STACK
MODEL_C_queue_actor_ownership_per_expedi.agent_recommendation: REJECTED_FOR_THIS_GATE · violates §12 principle (no new tech without evidence)

MODEL_D_single_worker_affinity_with_reco.writer_selection: sticky routing by expedition_id → single worker
MODEL_D_single_worker_affinity_with_reco.failover: worker crash → recovery loads checkpoint into new worker
